title: Opening: recording at Dawson's home, June 28, 1961
summary: Russell notes the address and date; Ralph Collins is present, and a visitor suggested asking about King Oliver and the brick.

story.theme_name: Starting the tape: names, dates and places
story.community_name: Interview openings: names, dates and tape setup

blocks.x: I'll make a note on here that we're interviewing Mr. Eddie Dawson at his home at 325 North Robertson and the date is June. No, not North Robertson, North Johnson. Johnson, I'll finally get it. North Johnson, yeah. I got the number wrong last night.

325 North Johnson and this is Bill Russell and Ralph Collins is here and the date is June the 28th, 1961. Well, I think I would have, Dick Allen just stopped by and I said what can we ask Mr. Dawson? He said ask about the time that the King Oliver used to drop the brick or something.
